summary: Trình quét lỗ hổng toàn diện cho containers, Kubernetes và mã nguồn để tìm vulnerabilities, misconfigurations và secrets.
usecases: Scanning container images in CI/CD pipelines to catch vulnerabilities before production deployment.
Identifying misconfigurations and hardcoded secrets in Kubernetes manifests and Helm charts.
Generating SBOMs for open-source dependency tracking and compliance auditing.
ideas: Integrate Trivy reports into custom dashboards for real-time security posture monitoring across environments.
Build a policy-as-code framework using Trivy's exit codes to enforce organizational security standards.
Extend scanning to private cloud artifact registries for hybrid environment security coverage.
